answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the shale queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. The tide index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 787 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the signal. A 107 account operation therefore ties up 4 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
